author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the playtest trailer for Parry the Bullet, a fast-paced one-hit-kill top-down action game developed by hogon2099. You play as a chicken knight in a medieval bird kingdom. Firearms have appeared out of nowhere. The crows used them to plunge the kingdom into chaos. You must stop them. Parry the Bullet will be available on PC (Steam) in February 2027. A playtest is out now on Steam.
title: Parry the Bullet - Official Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at a fresh Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis sneak peek revealed at TR30 Derby and MCM London. This latest preview teases even more iconic content from Lara Croft's upcoming adventure! Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis launches on February 12, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official 30th Anniversary Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Fort Burton, a top-down action RPG developed by Ledx. Play as the hero standing between an undead horde and total chaos. Take direct control of a legendary defender, build up your fortress with upgradeable towers and fighters, then throw yourself into wave after wave of enemies that very much want to ruin your day. Fort Burton is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Fort Burton - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch trailer for BROK: The Brawl Bar, a wild party beat 'em up game developed by COWCAT. Play as Brok, a former boxer turned detective, who stumbles upon an underground bar hidden deep in the Slums. Old instincts kick in, and he jumps headfirst to prove he’s still top dog (or...gator.) Tackle crazy challenges, fight your way to the top of an underground bar, and make unexpected friends along the way. BROK: The Brawl Bar is out now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PC (Steam), iOS, and Android.
title: BROK: The Brawl Bar - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Demon's Tier+, a dungeon-RPG roguelike developed by Diabolical Mind. Enter the dungeons of King Thosgar and destroy his demonic minions! Combining the best elements from Xenon Valkyrie+ and Riddled Corpses EX, this is the latest game in the Diabolical Mind trilogy! Demon's Tier+ is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, PC (Steam), iOS, and Android.
title: Demon's Tier+ - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Keres Skill Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile iteration of the hit open-world monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Keres wields dual blades, chaining rapid strikes into relentless combos with blinding speed. Some skills unlock enhanced follow-ups, overwhelming targets with an unending flurry of slashes. Monster Hunter Outlanders launches on October 29 on iOS and Android.
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Keres Skill Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Exciting times lie ahead, Time Patrollers... Get ready for the most epic Festival of Universes yet! 
Check out the Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 free update trailer and celebrate 10 years of Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 with the free 10th Anniversary Update!

The free update launches on October 27, and the Final Festival begins on October 30.
title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 - Official 10th Anniversary Free Update Trailer
